fn make_point(value: Float, scale: String) -> TemperaturePoint {
    temperature_point(value, scale)
}

fn shift(point: TemperaturePoint, delta: Quantity<Temperature>) -> TemperaturePoint {
    point + delta
}

fn difference(left: TemperaturePoint, right: TemperaturePoint) -> Quantity<Temperature> {
    left - right
}

fn main() -> Void {
    c = make_point(0.0, "degC")
    f = make_point(32.0, "degF")
    k = make_point(273.15, "K")
    cold_c = make_point(-40.0, "degC")
    cold_f = make_point(-40.0, "degF")
    assert(c == f)
    assert(c == k)
    assert(cold_c == cold_f)
    assert(c < shift(c, 0.1 K))
    moved = shift(c, 10.0 K)
    print(moved)
    print(difference(moved, c))
    print(difference(f, c))
    print(10.0 K + c)
    print(moved - (10.0 K))
    print(temperature_point_to(c, "degF"))
    assert(temperature_point_to(moved, "degF") == make_point(50.0, "degF"))
    print(310 K)
}
